components.css: .ds-discovery-card{max-width:540px;background:#fff;color:#252728;border:1px solid #bfd0dc;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;font:400 16px/1.6 "Red Hat Display",Raleway,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-discovery-photo{aspect-ratio:1.85;background:#dceaf3;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#455e6c}.ds-discovery-copy{padding:24px;display:grid;gap:18px}.ds-discovery-copy p{margin:0;color:#455e6c}.ds-discovery-copy h2{font:600 27px/1.3 "Red Hat Display",Raleway,Arial,sans-serif;margin:0}.ds-discovery-copy a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;color:#ae2119;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-discovery-copy a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-discovery-copy a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #195d7b;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The captured public WordPress website supplies the charcoal header, genuine combined logo, geometric display type, red capsules, source composition and native vehicle imagery. Light catalogue/comparison tools and charcoal forms inherit this identity; the dark Sora manager remains a separate staff environment. The owner-approved colourful showroom extends this identity only on /models and /compare, with pale blue canvases, charcoal selection panels and genuine photographic cards.
keyCharacteristics: Original source layout and authentic photography
Phone controls and readable stacked specifications

rules.name: Source fidelity
rules.body: Preserve the selected WordPress visual world and native artwork composition.

rules.name: Separate manager
rules.body: Keep the existing Sora dark manager scoped to staff workflows.

rules.name: Scoped discovery
rules.body: Use the colourful showroom only on /models and /compare; preserve other source layouts and the separate staff manager.

dos: Do use locally sourced original media and genuine combined logo.
Do keep phone labels, statuses, focus and controls readable.
donts: Don't restore the superseded Porsche-inspired public system.
Don't generate vehicle photos, recolour cars or invent specifications.
